overview: Retrospective review of laboratory information system call logs for all critical values verified by the core laboratory from January 2024 to December 2025.
population: Every critical value on the policy list verified in the period, from inpatient, emergency, outpatient and community clinic specimens; repeat critical values for the same patient and analyte within 24 hours are counted once, with the first notification kept.
exposure: Patient location (inpatient, emergency, outpatient, community clinic), time block of verification (08:00 to 16:59, 17:00 to 22:59, 23:00 to 07:59), weekday or weekend, analyte group, night staffing (single or two staff, from rosters) and number of call attempts.
procedures: The laboratory information system manager extracts de-identified call logs with verification time, each attempt time, person reached, read-back flag and location; the quality officer links night rosters by date and shift; the interval runs from verification to documented read-back.

outcomes.name: Read-back within 30 minutes
outcomes.measure: Documented read-back by a responsible clinician within 30 minutes of verification; a missing read-back time counts as not within 30 minutes
outcomes.why: The policy standard, measurable from reliable time stamps (claim c2).

outcomes.name: Never successfully notified
outcomes.measure: Critical values with no documented read-back at any time
outcomes.why: The most dangerous failure, hidden if only completed calls are analysed.

outcomes.name: Time to read-back
outcomes.measure: Minutes from verification to documented read-back, summarised by median and 90th percentile
outcomes.why: Shows the size of delays beyond the threshold.

outcomes.name: Read-back documentation
outcomes.measure: Proportion of successful calls with read-back documented
outcomes.why: Documentation quality affects the primary outcome.

feasibility: About 28,000 critical values in two years; extraction by the system manager; analysis within the quality officer's 60 hours.
biasMitigation: Interval and missing-time rule fixed before extraction
Repeat values within 24 hours counted once
Roster linkage done before outcomes are examined
Missing read-back times reported by location and time block

biasFlags.label: Missing read-back times
biasFlags.note: Treated as unsuccessful in the primary analysis; sensitivity analysis excludes them.

biasFlags.label: Location coding
biasFlags.note: Location is assigned by the ordering system, not by the technologist.

flags: Six pre-specified factors; no data-driven selection
parsimony.simplestPath: One binary outcome, six factors, one regression model.

theoreticalFramework: None needed; the review is descriptive with a pre-specified set of factors.
summary: Retrospective review of about 28,000 critical values with one primary outcome, two secondary outcomes and six pre-specified factors.
